args.rationale: Support: The report's key conclusions are directly grounded in the two available sources. Every earnings figure (revenue 60.801B +28%, operating income 18.775B -8%, margin 31% vs 43%, 2.40B legal + 1.18B severance, DAP 3.60B +3%, capex 31.08B) matches the frozen src-meta notes exactly. Every market figure (539.03 close, 526.00 open, 539.88 high, 524.49 low, 42.27M volume, 585.61 prior close, 681.31 July high, ~540.18 June low) matches the frozen market CSV. Derived figures (gap -7.96%, capex/revenue ~51%, pro-forma operating income ~22.36B / ~37% margin, 3.58B add-back) are correctly labeled as calculations and arithmetically sound. The report explicitly refuses to fabricate unavailable data (macro, prediction markets, TTM EPS) and marks valuation as UNKNOWN — a strength, not a gap. Only minor imprecision: the 'five of six down sessions' count is loosely supported by the cited series. Relevance: Fully on-task for META / 2026-07-30, with a coherent multi-role structure culminating in a clear Underweight rating and SELL proposal; some redundancy across the four risk-analyst sections but no off-topic drift. Semantic validity: No period/unit errors — the report never converts a quarterly figure to TTM/annual, never computes a trailing P/E from quarterly EPS, and explicitly flags trailing P/E as UNKNOWN for lack of TTM EPS evidence. The pro-forma margin is correctly framed as a derived calculation, not a reported figure. No unsupported numerical valuation assertion.
